items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Illinois and Newman and myself, we go up the street where the restaurants were... So we -- Illinois and Newman and myself, we go up the street... I ended up paying the whole tab.

ctx.x: And then it seemed like guys like Buddy Tate and Jaquet and that kind of came from Herschel.
Buddy copied Herschel, because Buddy took Herschel's place in Basie's band. And Illinois Jaquet has got a lot of Lester Young in him.
